cohort: 513 pregnant women (172 with abnormal placentation and 341 with normal placentation)
finding: The presence of placenta previa has a close relationship with abnormal placentation and is considered to be a potential risk factor for LBW, SGA, lower 5 minutes Apgar scores, first-day seizure, cranial hemorrhage, the necessity for NICU admission and occurrence of anemia and thrombocytosis in neonates.
gest_age: Reported (lower in the abnormal placentation group)
birth_weight: Reported (lower in the abnormal placentation group)
